newsitem.title: GERMANY: German sugar beet harvest raised to 26.06 mln T.
newsitem.headline: German sugar beet harvest raised to 26.06 mln T.

text.p: German sugar industry association WVZ raised its 1996/97 final beet deliveries figure to 26.06 million tonnes in its 13th campaign report from 25.96 million in the 12th report on Dec 17.
Some 26.05 million tonnes were delivered in 1995/96.
The report said the final 26.06 million tonnes of beet had been received by refineries as of Jan 3. A year earlier, the figure was 26.02 million as the campaign had not yet ended.
Average sugar content on Jan 3 was 18.17 percent, the same as in the last report, and compared with 16.73 percent a year ago.
Late harvesting efforts brought good volumes while sugar content had been high throughout the campaign, aided by favourable weather, analysts said.
WVZ put sugar production from the newly harvested 96/97 beet at 4.16 million tonnes, whites value, compared with 3.79 million tonnes in 95/96. --Vera Eckert, Hamburg newsroom +49-40-41903275
